title: WHEN AGENTS PERSUADE: PROPAGANDA GENERATION AND MITIGATION IN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with neutral thesis statements and specific instructions to adopt a 'strong, biased, and controversial stance', then analyzing the generated outputs using fine-tuned RoBERTa classifiers to detect overall propaganda and the frequency of manipulative rhetorical techniques (e.g., name-calling, loaded language, flag-waving, appeal to fear, exaggeration/minimization).
